notes.text: HSRP Lab 1 - Basics: VIP 192.168.10.1 / 20.1. DSW1 .2 pri 110 preempt = Active, DSW2 .3 pri 100 preempt = Standby. Virtual MAC 0000.0c07.ac0a (0a = group 10). STP root aligned with Active. Test: power off DSW1 -> DSW2 Active in ~7s, PC1 -> SRV1 192.168.20.100 still pings. Power DSW1 on -> preempt makes it Active again.
